description: This file declares the EnoughData class, which is a task related to media playback, specifically handling the 'enough data' state in a media player context. It includes references to external GStreamer components and a custom player context, and it defines the class interface for executing the task.

classes.name: EnoughData
classes.description: A class representing a task that signals sufficient data has been buffered in the media player, inheriting from IPlayerTask.

methods.name: EnoughData
methods.description: Constructor initializing the task with a player context and a GStreamer app source.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task, likely signaling that enough data has been buffered.
